title: fix(plugin-report): a report the viewer may not read shows the no-access state, not the server's refusal (objectui#12330)
body:
Fixes #12330
Clause-②: yes (widening). Every published locale pack of `@object-ui/i18n` gains one key, `report.forbiddenMessage`, which widens the exported `TranslationKeys` type. No export, prop, schema key or accepted input is added, and nothing is renamed or removed. The claim said `no` before the wording was measured; no existing key's words fit a report (below).

## What was wrong

A report whose dataset the viewer may not read drew the adapter's raw refusal in a red error box: "Analytics query refused: this user may not read the data behind dataset "…". (server said: [Analytics] Access denied: reading "…" is not permitted for this user.)". That text quotes the server and names the object. A dashboard widget refused the same way already drew a localized "You don't have access" panel (objectui#10899), because `DatasetWidget` classifies the rejection through the shared `classifyLoadError`. The report's dataset read (`useDatasetRows` in `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`) had no such branch.

## What changed

- **`useDatasetRows`' `.catch`** asks the shared `classifyLoadError` (`@object-ui/react`) once. A `forbidden` verdict sets `{ status: 'error', forbidden: true }` and keeps no `error` text, so the adapter's message cannot reach the page. Every other failure keeps `{ status: 'error', error: message }`, as before. No message matching, no second classifier.
- **`FetchStates`** draws a `NoAccess` state for a forbidden error (`data-testid="dataset-report-forbidden"`): the widget's title `dashboard.widgetForbiddenTitle` ("You don't have access") and a new `report.forbiddenMessage` ("You don't have permission to view the data behind this report."). The table and the cross-tab pass `state.forbidden` to it, so summary, tabular, matrix and each joined block draw it.
- **The chart slot is unchanged in behaviour.** It already returns nothing when its own query fails. A refusal is an error there too, so the table beside it draws the one state. Its comment now says so.
- `report.forbiddenMessage` in all ten packs (translated from each pack's `dashboard.widgetForbiddenMessage`, with the pack's own word for "report"). A paragraph in the package README. Changeset `.changeset/12330-report-no-access-state.md`: `@object-ui/plugin-report` `patch`, `@object-ui/i18n` `minor` (the widening; raised in the patch round after contract review 6158000763).
- `DatasetWidget.tsx` and `@object-ui/data-objectstack` are read, not changed. No `package.json` or lockfile is touched.

### Why a new message key

The title reuses the widget's key, so a report and a widget read the same title in every pack. No existing message fits a report: the widget's names "this widget", the list view's names "these records", and `console.objectData.noAccess` belongs to the console's object-data page and pairs with a different title ("Access denied"). So one `report.*` key was added, in every pack.

## Measurements

All test runs went through the shared verify lock. The code under test is commit `5bccaeb5f`. `e407ce4f9` (the head) changes only the changeset's last paragraph (`git diff --stat 5bccaeb5f e407ce4f9`: 1 file, the changeset).

| Leg | What ran | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Red on the BASE renderer | renderer bytes of `72594f29e` written over the file (blob `493a305f3` = BASE blob; `classifyLoadError` count 0), new test file unchanged | `Tests 7 failed / 1 passed (8)`. The failure DOM shows the raw "Analytics query refused: … (server said: [Analytics] Access denied: reading "crm_opportunity" …)" text on screen. The one pass is the 500 control. Restored: blob `2b2d59d8f` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. |
| Ablation | `classifyLoadError(e) === 'forbidden'` replaced by `false` through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `2b2d59d8f` to `736eeb794`) | `Tests 7 failed / 1 passed (8)`, same seven. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. |
| Green | `vitest run packages/plugin-report/ packages/i18n/` plus the four outside suites that render the real renderer: the three `apps/console` `drillDownReport.*` tests and `ReportPreview.dataset.test.tsx` (re-derived by grep; the `ReportView.*` and `dataPreviews.i18n` suites mock the package) | `Test Files 115 passed (115)`, `Tests 1594 passed / 20 skipped`. 115 = 28 plugin-report + 83 i18n + 4 outside test files. |
| Real adapter (one-off probe, not committed) | the real `ObjectStackAdapter`, its fetch answering `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` with 403 `{ code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED' }`, then the real renderer on that adapter | `classifyLoadError(err) === 'forbidden'` on the thrown `AnalyticsForbiddenError`, and the page draws `dataset-report-forbidden` with no server text. A 500 `ANALYTICS_QUERY_FAILED` keeps the error box and draws no no-access state. `Tests 2 passed (2)`. The adapter's error already carries `httpStatus: 403` and `code: 'PERMISSION_DENIED'`, so the producer needed no change. |

The new test file pins: the adapter's shape, a status alone and a code alone each draw the state with none of the server text; a zh console reads the zh state; the cross-tab and each joined block draw it; a report with a chart draws exactly one state, no plot and no "Loading chart…" (both queries were sent and refused); a 500 keeps its error box and message.

## Gates

Read on `e407ce4f9` unless noted.

| Gate | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/plugin-report^...` (on `5bccaeb5f`) | 11 of 11 tasks successful |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-report type-check` (on `5bccaeb5f`; the script name echoed, both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` ran) | exit 0 |
| eslint on the 12 touched `.ts`/`.tsx` files, repo config, inline config honoured (on `5bccaeb5f`; the 12 files are byte-identical at `e407ce4f9`) | 12 files, 0 errors, 5 warnings; the BASE renderer bytes give the same 5 warnings by rule, the test and the packs give none |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check-changeset-no-major` | exit 0 |
| `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:doc-fences` | exit 0 |
| `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` | exit 0 (call-site keys resolve and match `en`; no `en` value changed) |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 14 paths | NOT GOVERNED |

The eslint narrowing: the population is the repo config's `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']` block; the count (12) is read from `--format json`; the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, `tseslint.configs.recommended`) and no custom rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

NOT MEASURED, left to CI: `check:readme-exports` (needs every package's `dist`; this README edit adds no code fence), `check:eager-locale-catalogues` and `check:doc-snippets` (both need a console or docs build; each pack gains one string).

## Acceptance notes

Observations outside this card, not filed:

- A report whose `values` is empty but whose `chart` names a `yAxis` shows the "choose at least one measure" note. If the chart's own query is refused, the chart returns nothing, as it does for any chart error, so no refusal is shown. Carrier: none.
- Other analytics failures still show the adapter's English message in the error box, for example the 401 "Analytics query refused: this session is not authenticated …" text. The triage keeps those as errors; the dashboard widget does the same.
- `This data source does not support dataset queries.` in `useDatasetRows` is a hard-coded English string. Carrier: none.

The app half (whether this persona should see the report entry at all) is hotcrm#2060 item 5 and is not touched here.
